issues.description: The client-side update operation uses inconsistent method names for the same conceptual action: NoteController exposes editNote(...) while PersonController exposes updatePerson(...). The problem statement and exercises describe updating entities as 'update' (e.g., 'updatePerson' / PUT), and students are instructed to look at the note-related code for guidance. Having 'edit' for notes but 'update' for persons creates a mild cognitive mapping burden when students look for the analogous method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make update-operation naming consistent across controllers and documentation. Rename NoteController.editNote(...) to NoteController.updateNote(...) (or alternatively rename PersonController.updatePerson(...) to editPerson(...)) so both entities use the same verb for the same conceptual action (recommended: use 'update' to match the problem statement and REST PUT semantics). Update any references in docs and examples accordingly.
